title: Compute uncorrelated kinetic energy function
action: Construct the tight-binding Hamiltonian for a two-degenerate-e_g-orbital model on a simple cubic lattice using the published Slater–Koster hopping parameters (1NN and 2NN). Compute the density of states and the uncorrelated kinetic energy per single-particle label ɛ̄(m) as a function of occupancy m. This function is required for subsequent variational energy functionals.

title: Hartree–Fock magnetization curves (supporting)
action: Implement Hartree–Fock mean-field decoupling for the same two-orbital model. Minimize the HF total energy with respect to magnetization Δ for a grid of U values (with J=0.2U, U'=U−2J) at fillings m=0.35 and m=0.30. Save the obtained magnetization versus U as a supporting artifact.
description: Hartree–Fock magnetization curves for comparison; not scored but required to demonstrate the full pipeline.
output_schema: CSV with columns: U (eV), HF magnetization for m=0.35, HF magnetization for m=0.30.

title: Gutzwiller magnetization curves (scored)
action: Implement the generalized Gutzwiller variational energy functional with seven multiple-occupancy parameters and the spin-splitting variational parameter Δ. For fillings m=0.35 and m=0.30, minimize the energy numerically over a grid of interaction strengths U (J=0.2U, U'=U−2J) to obtain the equilibrium magnetization Δ. Write the results to a CSV.
description: Main scored artifact: Gutzwiller magnetization Δ as a function of U for two band fillings, reproducing the paper's Figure 1 magnetization curves.
output_schema: Columns: U (float, eV), delta_G_m0.35 (float, dimensionless magnetization), delta_G_m0.30 (float, dimensionless magnetization). At least 20 points per filling.

title: Gutzwiller magnetic phase diagram (scored)
action: For filling m=0.30, vary the ratio J/U from 0 to 0.4. For each ratio, determine the critical interaction strength U_c where the Gutzwiller ground state acquires a non-zero magnetization Δ (onset of ferromagnetism). Save the phase boundary to a CSV.
description: Scored artifact: Gutzwiller magnetic phase boundary in the J/U vs U plane, reproducing the paper's Figure 3 for m=0.3.
output_schema: Columns: J_over_U (float, dimensionless), U_c (float, eV). At least 10 points covering J/U from 0 to 0.4.
